nodes.label: AI Coach Illustration
nodes.description: Simple line-art icon of a person (coach/trainer) rendered in yellow/gold color on a white background. The figure is shown from the torso up wearing what appears to be a medal or badge, representing an AI fitness coach or trainer persona used throughout the IFit app UI. Minimal flat icon style consistent with app branding.
nodes.visual_style: flat icon, monochrome yellow/gold, line art, minimal
nodes.purpose: Represents the AI coach concept in the app — used in coach selection screens, onboarding flow, and coach-related UI elements
nodes.app_context: AI fitness coach character identity; associated with CoachModelType selection and AI routine generation features
